Bihar men samrat chaudhri ki sarkar ke samne vittiy varsh 2026-27 ke bajat ki rashi jutane aur kharch karne ka dohra sankat hai. kendriy karon par barhti nirbharta aur mupht yojnaon ke bojh ke karan ab sarkari karmachariyon ke vetan aur penshan bhugtan men bhi deri ho rahi hai.
